title: YRL Publishes Foundational Governance Structure and Official Notices
author: YRL Interim Legal and Governance Working Group
excerpt: Official declarations published on the institutional notice board clarify YRL's independent civic status, voluntary charter, and foundational interim governance roadmap.
content: The Interim Legal and Governance Working Group of Youth Republic Leadership (YRL) has published the organisation's foundational governance structure alongside six comprehensive institutional notices on the public portal.

The published declarations formally reaffirm that Youth Republic Leadership is an independent, non-partisan, non-governmental civic organisation in Ghana. All interim positions within the organisation are entirely voluntary and civic in nature, and do not constitute positions, offices, or employment in the Government of Ghana.

The declarations also establish a strict, zero-tolerance policy against monetary solicitation: nominations, memberships, and participation in all YRL initiatives are 100% free. Any individual or third party requesting payment or consideration in connection with YRL does so fraudulently and without authorisation.
Citizens and prospective applicants are encouraged to review the official institutional declarations on the Official Notice Board at /notice to ensure full transparency and civic alignment.
